disclaimer: Discount terms are summarized from each brand's published veteran offer and may vary by franchise. Always confirm at the register before paying.

stores.name: Applebee's — New York
stores.discountDescription: 10% off entire check year-round (Veterans Day: free meal)
stores.howToRedeem: Show veteran ID or DD-214 card to your server before paying.

stores.name: Chili's — New York
stores.discountDescription: 10% off plus free chips & salsa with valid ID
stores.howToRedeem: Tell your server you are a veteran when you order.

stores.name: Denny's — New York
stores.discountDescription: 10% off any check, all day, every day
stores.howToRedeem: Mention 'veteran discount' before the check is dropped.

stores.name: Buffalo Wild Wings — New York
stores.discountDescription: 10% off — Heroes Discount in participating locations
stores.howToRedeem: Show veteran ID at the table; honored at most franchise locations.

stores.name: Home Depot — New York
stores.discountDescription: 10% off everyday for verified veterans (cap $400/yr)
stores.howToRedeem: Verify once at homedepot.com/military, then scan your barcode at checkout.

stores.name: Lowe's — New York
stores.discountDescription: 10% off everyday for veterans, active duty, and immediate family
stores.howToRedeem: Enroll in MyLowe's, verify with ID.me, then sign in at the register.

stores.name: Target — New York
stores.discountDescription: 10% off Circle Week purchases for verified veterans (annual)
stores.howToRedeem: Verify on target.com/circle once per year; auto-applies in app.

stores.discountDescription: Member-only deals + occasional 10% off events for veterans
stores.howToRedeem: Verify on bestbuy.com/military with ID.me; offers appear in your account.

stores.discountDescription: Military rate at participating brands; member events for veterans
